red05052: Marek Red left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out. The men noticed at once that he counts everything: steps, shells, stars.

Marek Red (Concord) and Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Calvary Farm. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. Verdel Ridge has been won. Marek Red listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Marek Red raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F16. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gideon Allistofeari of the Hegemony (@allistofearisgod).
The medics cleaned Marek Red's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F16.
sus.danny2.0: Day 3. The corporal put Quentin "Shadow" Danny beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Severin Lagbagdotzip of the Hegemony (@lagbagdotzip). Quentin "Shadow" Danny fired at a movement across the wire at R-F18. The man went down: Lucien Jewnipers, gravely wounded.

Quentin "Shadow" Danny no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Mail came up the line with a letter for Quentin "Shadow" Danny. Quentin "Shadow" Danny read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
twenskyyy: Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy came up with a draft of replacements on Day 4. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Benedikt "Mole" Twenskyyy thought about an old father who runs the family shop alone on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
